description: Building robust applications and securing network infrastructure — from the code layer to the network packet.

faq.question: What is your current availability?
faq.answer: I'm currently a student at ENSPY and available for internships or freelance missions alongside my studies. I can adapt to project timelines while maintaining a balance with my academic schedule.

faq.question: Why this dual Dev and Network profile?
faq.answer: To understand systems from the software layer all the way down to physical data transmission — a crucial perspective for cybersecurity. This approach lets me see the full picture: from network infrastructure to user-facing applications, which is essential for identifying and fixing vulnerabilities.

faq.question: What are your next technical goals?
faq.answer: Deepening offensive security through penetration testing practice and earning professional certifications, specifically Cisco CCNA and CompTIA Security+. I'm also continuing to develop my skills in vulnerability analysis and secure infrastructure administration.

faq.question: Are you open to freelance or remote work?
faq.answer: Yes, absolutely. I'm open to remote collaborations and short-term missions on backend projects, REST APIs, microservice architectures, or application security hardening. Feel free to reach out via the contact form below to discuss your needs.
